intro.background: 教玩具是大件货，物流和标准品完全不同。KD拆装包装（Knock Down）是标准做法——散件打包，现场组装。熏蒸（Fumigation）是木质包装必须做的，IPPC标识。整柜FCL（20GP/40HQ）适合整园项目，拼柜LCL适合小批量。体积计算CBM是基本功。
intro.desc: 掌握大件包装、熏蒸、整柜拼柜的英语表达。

oneLiner.en: For big wooden play equipment, shipping is not just freight — it is KD packing, IPPC fumigation and container loading.
oneLiner.cn: 大型木质游乐设备的运输不只是运费——而是KD拆装、IPPC熏蒸和装柜。

vocab.ex: We use KD packing for easy container loading.
FCL (Full Container Load) is for large orders.
LCL (Less than Container Load) is for small orders.
All wooden crates have IPPC stamps.

mistakes.wrong: We will pack it in a box.
mistakes.right: We use KD export packing, fumigated wooden crates with IPPC marks, loaded into a 40HQ container.
mistakes.cn: 错误：说装箱。要具体说KD包装、熏蒸、柜型。

advanced.en: The total volume is 45 CBM, which fits into one 40HQ container. We use KD export packing with fumigated wooden crates bearing IPPC marks.
advanced.cn: 总体积45立方，刚好一个40HQ。我们用KD出口包装，熏蒸木托带IPPC章。

advanced.en: For small orders under 15 CBM, we recommend LCL consolidation at our warehouse in Ningbo, with all packaging ISPM-15 compliant.
advanced.cn: 15立方以下小订单，我们建议在宁波仓拼柜，所有包装符合ISPM-15。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: How will you ship the furniture?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Total volume is about 45 CBM, which fits one 40HQ container. We use KD packing, fumigated wooden crates with IPPC marks.
lines.cn: 总体积约45立方，一个40HQ刚好。我们用KD包装，熏蒸木托带IPPC章。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Is the packaging strong enough for long sea freight?
lines.cn: 包装够结实扛长途海运吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Absolutely. All edges are foam-protected, cartons are 5-layer corrugated, and we provide loading photos before shipment.
lines.cn: 当然。所有边缘泡沫保护，纸箱5层瓦楞，发货前提供装柜照片。

fillBlank.q: Wooden packaging needs ____ and IPPC marks.

scenario.q: A client asks how the furniture will be shipped. Reply.
scenario.modelAnswer: The total volume is about 45 CBM, fitting one 40HQ container. We use KD export packing with fumigated wooden crates bearing IPPC marks. All edges are foam-protected and cartons are 5-layer corrugated. We will provide container loading photos before shipment.
scenario.cn: 总体积约45立方，一个40HQ。KD出口包装，熏蒸木托带IPPC章。所有边缘泡沫保护，5层瓦楞纸箱。发货前提供装柜照片。

culture.title: 木质包装的规矩
culture.content: 出口木质包装必须做熏蒸（ISPM-15），盖IPPC章。用胶合板（plywood）不用实木就免熏蒸——很多厂用这个省成本。但客户问起要如实说。
